status: BLOCKED -- no ECOFF value was obtainable from this environment
step: Step 1 -- Source the EUCAST ECOFFs and pin them with provenance
what_was_required: A per-drug E. coli ECOFF in mg/L, each carrying source_url + verbatim_quote. The plan forbids recalling these values: a wrong ECOFF produces a fully self-consistent evaluation that is entirely wrong, with nothing downstream able to catch it.

attempts.route: EUCAST MIC/zone distribution search (result URL with query parameters)
attempts.outcome: Returned the search FORM, not results. The interface is JavaScript-driven; values are not addressable by query parameters.

attempts.route: EUCAST search form -- extract the <option> value IDs to build a result URL
attempts.outcome: The antibiotic and species dropdown options are rendered client-side; the option value attributes are not present in the served HTML, so no result URL could be constructed.

attempts.route: EUCAST rationale document (ciprofloxacin), as an authoritative PDF
attempts.outcome: Fetched and text-extracted successfully (13 pages). It does NOT carry the value. Section 2 in full: 'MIC distributions and epidemiological cut-off (ECOFF) values. MIC distributions and ECOFFs can be found at https://mic.eucast.org/...'. A redirect, not a number.
attempts.verbatim_quote: 2. MIC distributions and epidemiological cut-off (ECOFF) values MIC distributions and ECOFFs can be found at https://mic.eucast.org/Eucast2/SearchController/search.jsp?action=init

attempts.route: EUCAST canonical ECOFF landing page cited by this repo's own datasource census
attempts.outcome: HTTP 303 redirect to https://mic.eucast.org/. That page confirms there is NO downloadable compiled ECOFF file (Excel/CSV/PDF) and NO documented stable URL pattern for a single species+antibiotic result; the ECOFF is only rendered inside the interactive database graph.

attempts.route: Direct HTTP via curl, bypassing the fetch tool
attempts.outcome: TLS/CA failure on this host ('could not establish a secure connection'). An environment fault, not a EUCAST one.

attempts.route: Local repo -- check whether a value was already sourced and committed
attempts.url: grep over research_outputs/, scripts/, wiki/, project_state/
attempts.outcome: No ECOFF value is stored anywhere in this repo. Every mention is a pointer to the aggregate EUCAST resource. `scripts/bvbrc_strict_mic_4drug_census.py` and `mic_tiers.py` both note only that tetracycline has 'no EUCAST breakpoints for E. coli (ECOFF only)' -- a statement about the clinical catalog, not a value.

explicitly_not_done: No value was written from memory. The search assistant volunteered 'the commonly cited 0.06 mg/L ciprofloxacin and 2 mg/L gentamicin ECOFFs' as a paraphrase; that is not a sourced quote and was NOT accepted.

No secondary source (e.g. an EFSA/ECDC summary report quoting EUCAST ECOFFs) was substituted. The plan specified EUCAST as the source, and the plan's third Open Question -- which EUCAST release to pin -- is still unresolved and is a user decision. Swapping the source class mid-execution to avoid a stall would be scope drift.
consequence: Step 2 (substrate feasibility gate) cannot screen any drug, so Steps 3, 5 and 7 cannot produce a measurement. The plan's own Risk Flag anticipated exactly this: 'Network dependency. Step 1 needs the EUCAST site. If it is unreachable the plan stalls at Wave 0 rather than proceeding on recalled values.'
unblock_paths: A human opens https://mic.eucast.org/search/, selects Escherichia coli and each agent, reads the ECOFF from the bottom-left of each graph, and pastes value + URL + verbatim quote into dna_decode/data/ecoff_catalog.py. Everything downstream is then already built and will run.
Authorize a secondary source (EFSA/ECDC EU Summary Report on AMR tabulates EUCAST ECOFFs). This changes the provenance class and should be an explicit decision, not a silent substitution.
Resolve the open question of WHICH EUCAST release to pin first -- mixing releases across the ECOFF arm and the clinical arm would confound the very comparison the plan exists to make.
what_was_still_built: dna_decode/data/ecoff_catalog.py -- the catalog with the provenance contract enforced: a value cannot be added without a source_url and a verbatim_quote, and ecoff_for() RAISES rather than defaulting. This is the seam the values drop into.
dna_decode/eval/wildtype_tiering.py -- classify_wildtype(mics, ecoff) plus ecoff_is_resolvable_on_grid(), both pure and fully testable without any ECOFF value, since the cut-off is a parameter.
